title: ὁ δεινόσαυρος ἄρτον ἀγοράζει
learning_goal: Practice infinitive complements with δεῖ and δύναμαι/θέλω in a simple market errand, reinforcing present-tense narration and core trade vocabulary like ἄρτος and νόμισμα.
plot: Hungry Dinosaur leaves home, goes to the agora, pays coins to a kind merchant, and happily eats bread.

tall clay jar: a smooth tan ceramic jar with a narrow neck and a thin blue painted band.

positioning: Dinosaur stands center-left beside the low table, three-quarter view facing right, eyes glancing from the table toward the bread basket on the shelf.
The low wooden table sits foreground left, top surface visible at knee height.
